Subject: SaaSOps discovery recap + counsel review — next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- What we heard: you want an inference runtime that can 1) integrate with your existing auth and audit pipeline, 2) deliver predictable <100ms p95 latency for customer-facing features, and 3) give finance predictable unit economics for scale.
- Redwood fit: Hosted API for quick PoC, Dedicated pool for predictable latency at scale; Private deployment if you need VPC/KMS controls.
- Action items from our side (Karthik): share an MAC (mutual action plan) and a draft T&Cs response for counsel by EOD tomorrow.
- Action items from your side (Alex): share any standard procurement terms or a contact for legal/counsel so we can route redlines.

I've attached a one-page mutual-action-plan and marked obvious spots where procurement typically asks for changes. If you'd like, Monica can join a short call with your legal team to walk through the redlines.

Attachments: SaaSOps_mutual-action-plan.pdf

Thanks — available Wed/Thu afternoon if you want to book time.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@saasops.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: SaaSOps redlines (attached) — questions on data retention and audit logs

Karthik / Monica,

Please find attached our redlines to the latest T&Cs. Two quick items we want to confirm before we go to execs: 
1) Data retention: we need a guaranteed 90-day configurable retention window for customer-generated cache + explicit export procedures.
2) Audit logs: requirement for per-token traces for 12 months (we're open to sampled traces if you can document sampling semantics).

I've attached SaaSOps_Redlines_v2.docx with comments. If you can respond to comments and propose language for the retention/audit clauses, we can aim to close this next week. Happy to set a short counsel-to-counsel call if that helps.

Attachments: SaaSOps_Redlines_v2.docx

Subject: Checking in on counsel redlines — offer to join call + pilot credit

Hi Jen / Alex — following up on the redlines you sent last week. Wanted to check status and offer a couple of things that might speed review: 

1) Counsel-to-counsel call: Monica (cc'd, our security/compliance lead) can join a 30-min call to walk through the retention and audit-log options and explain our sampling semantics and export tooling. If helpful, we can use a shared doc to capture agreed language live.

2) Pilot economics: to make the PoC low friction we can offer a 2-week Dedicated pilot with a $5k credit and explicit documented retention configuration for the pilot environment. That gives your team a chance to validate latency and the audit/export workflows without full commitment.

3) Timeline ask: are you expecting counsel to push an updated redline back this week? If timelines have shifted we can re-prioritize internally — let me know what would help.

Attachments referenced: SaaSOps_Redlines_v2.docx, SaaSOps_mutual-action-plan.pdf

If you'd like, I can propose three 30-min windows for counsel sync tomorrow/Thu. Otherwise, a quick reply with a target date for the next redline is great.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
